corrections.text: The article quotes Nvidia's license description as "as permissive as possible." Nvidia's developer blog actually says the weights, training data, and recipes are released "as permissively as possible" (adverb, not adjective). The license itself, OpenMDW-1.1, is correctly identified.

The article states that "SiliconANGLE additionally names Cognition AI as a partner" working with Nvidia on intelligent routing, implying Nvidia's own blog did not. Nvidia's NeMo Switchyard blog post also names Cognition directly, alongside Kong, Classmethod, Boomi, Cadence, Siemens, Ramp, and Nous Research.
